description: The brand's TYPED custom fields on contacts. action list (default): every definition with its type and how many contacts hold a value, plus free-text fields with no definition. create { name, slug? (from the name), type text | number | date | boolean | select, options (select only) }. update { id or slug, name?, options? } (the type and slug never change). delete { id or slug, clearValues? (default true: every contact's value goes too) } needs confirm:true when any contact holds a value. A value is set per contact with save_contacts fields { slug: value } (null clears it); a defined field's value is checked against its type and stored in one spelling (number, YYYY-MM-DD, true/false, or one of the options), and a wrong one is refused in words. manage_broadcasts filters on these (segment.customFields). Free.

clearValues.description: delete: also clear every contact's value (default true)

confirm.description: delete: REQUIRED true when contacts hold a value

name: manage_contact_fields
title: Contact custom fields
